title: The Mpemba Effect: Why Hot Water Can Freeze Faster Than Cold
question: Under the right conditions, can hot water actually freeze faster than cold water, and if so, why has such a simple claim resisted a clean scientific explanation for centuries?
summary: Aristotle noticed it, a Tanzanian high schooler named Erasto Mpemba rediscovered it in the 1960s doing homework, and physicists are still arguing about whether it's real, and if so, which of at least six competing mechanisms actually causes it.
